verdict.stance: Neutral / Largest Turkish State Bank Crossing TRY 10.1tn Assets (BB- / Ba3)
verdict.summary: Ziraat became Turkey's first bank to exceed TRY 10.1tn in assets at 9M26, generating TRY 124.5bn net profit with NPLs contained at 2.0% (well below ~3% sector average). 100% Türkiye Wealth Fund ownership anchors systemic support, though subsidized agricultural/SME policy lending and sovereign ceiling cap ratings at BB-/Ba3.

positives: 100% owned by Türkiye Wealth Fund (TWF); Turkey's #1 bank by assets (TRY 10.1tn at 9M26).
Superior asset quality vs sector (2.0% NPL vs ~3.0% system) and strong 18.6% YE25 CAR.
9M26 net profit of TRY 124.5bn supports internal capital generation.
negatives: Policy-mandated agricultural/SME lending caps NIM upside relative to private Turkish peers.
Direct sovereign rating linkage and FX deposit dollarization sensitivity.
Direct linkage to Turkey sovereign credit ceiling, local policy rate cycles, and FX volatility.

background.business_overview: Largest state-owned commercial and agricultural bank in Türkiye.
background.asset_perimeter: Corporate, SME, agricultural, retail, and international banking (Azerbaijan, Bosnia, Uzbekistan, Georgia, Europe).
